fit_reason: Whole van listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: White paint on the sides, nose and rear doors looks clean and even in all exterior shots
Black lower bumpers and side cladding look dark, not faded

Interior only seen briefly through the open sliding door, so the cabin can't be judged closely
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Transit high roof. It already looks sharp, with clean white paint and dark black trim. If you'd like it fully finished before showings, we do a mobile pre-sale wash, wax and interior wipe-down that comes to you. Would you like a quote?
